answer: You can still sell us the car, but you'll pay the difference between our offer and your loan balance at the appointment, after we compare the offer with your payoff letter. So bring your payoff letter, plus a cashier's check or a debit card for the difference. We no longer accept personal checks, and we don't accept credit cards. The help center doesn't cover anything specific to Coastal Credit Union or give a complete list of what to bring, so please contact a store to confirm.
